verdict:
KILL. The superseding triage argues its own kill and argues it well, and the decisive work is a cause-check that inverts the entire premise.

THE DISLOCATION DOES NOT EXIST. OLMA's -70.7% drawdown is measured off a $36.26 high set on 2025-11-18, the day ROCHE's giredestrant won lidERA in early/curative breast cancer and OLMA gapped +197% on NO Olema news whatsoever - and management launched a stock-plus-pre-funded-warrant offering that same day. The 52-week high is BORROWED. The cohort narrative now being sold (Roche's persevERA 1L failure means the oral-SERD mechanism has limits) is the identical read-across running in reverse. On enterprise value OLMA sits near the TOP of its own twelve-month range, not the bottom: at $10.63 on roughly 104.5M weighted diluted shares including pre-funded warrants, market cap is about $1.11B and EV about $650M, whereas at the $5.34 low the entire market cap was roughly the cash balance and the pipeline was free. The market is not pricing the bear narrative; it is holding a large premium to where the stock stood before Roche's OTHER trial won.

THE CAP-STRUCTURE ERROR IS THE SECOND INDEPENDENT REASON THE SCREEN IS WRONG. The 10-Q cover shows 87,497,607 common outstanding at 2026-08-06 PLUS 13,594,149 pre-funded warrants at $0.0001, immediately exercisable. The economic share count is 101.1M, not 87.5M, so vendor screens understate market cap and EV by about 13.5%. Any implied-probability-of-success or EV-per-program arithmetic built on the 87.5M count is simply wrong. This is the pull-cap-structure-first rule firing again, and it is the third or fourth time the same omission has changed a valuation at this desk.

AND THE DECISIVE DATUM IS UNOBSERVABLE UNTIL Q1 2027. OPERA-01's BICR-assessed PFS, scored separately in ESR1-mutation-detected and not-detected populations, is the only thing that resolves the mechanism claim. There is no interim, no DSMB disclosure, and the ~2026-11-09 financial print carries NO metric that moves it. A court cannot test this prior; it can only re-set it. Per the doctrine that ruled Z this same day, an unpriceable binary gets a GATE, not a sized position - and size-cutting is not an available instrument for unpriceability.

THE ONE REAL ANALYTIC FINDING, WHICH SHOULD SURVIVE INTO THE GRAPH EVEN THOUGH THE NAME DIES: the class read-across is HALF wrong and HALF right, and both halves are checkable. persevERA failed in 1L, endocrine-naive, CDK4/6-combination, ESR1-wild-type-dominant disease. OPERA-01 is 2L/3L monotherapy versus investigator's-choice fulvestrant or AI after a mandatory prior CDK4/6 line - a near-replica of EMERALD, where an oral SERD (elacestrant) beat that same control and won FDA approval RESTRICTED to the ESR1-mutated population, with HR about 0.55 and median PFS 3.8 versus 1.9 months. So the read-across does NOT govern OPERA-01's ESR1-mutated co-primary - but it points the SAME way as elacestrant's own ITT shortfall on the ESR1-wild-type co-primary, which is exactly where palazestrant's CERAN differentiation claim lives and where no public datum resolves anything before Q1 2027. Worse for the franchise: OPERA-02 (palazestrant plus ribociclib versus letrozole plus ribociclib, 1L, n=1,000, data 2028) takes the persevERA hit almost setting-for-setting, and that is where the R&D ramp is going (Q2-26 R&D $57.8M versus $43.9M).

The solvency and operational legs are genuinely damage-absent - $461.1M cash and securities at 6/30/26 against a $63.2M quarterly net loss is roughly seven quarters of runway, so the company is funded about four quarters PAST topline with no forced pre-data raise, the trial is fully enrolled, OP-3136 is showing tumour shrinkage in Phase 1 and there is a Bayer/darolutamide mCRPC collaboration. But those legs were never what the cohort was selling. Funded is not the same as cheap, and a funded unpriceable binary at a premium EV is a gate, not a starter.

reopen_gates: PRICE (the triage's own gate, and it is well-founded): at or below roughly $7, i.e. EV under about $270M, where the ESR1-mutated co-primary starts being free. Note this gate must be computed on the 101.1M ECONOMIC share count including the 13,594,149 pre-funded warrants - not the 87.5M cover count the screens use.

EVENT: a company PR that CONFIRMS the OPERA-01 topline window, or that discloses an interim analysis or any DSMB action. Today the guidance is 'Q1 2027' with no date and no interim - a confirmed window is what makes the binary tradeable rather than merely held.
EVENT: a Roche pionERA or AstraZeneca camizestrant readout that re-fires the class read-across in either direction - this is the only way the prior moves before OLMA's own data.

DATA: guidance-credibility check at the next print. Management guided 'fall 2026' as late as the 2026-05-12 Q1 release, when the Q1-2027 topline was already arithmetically forced by the 2025-05-23 re-opening of enrollment. That is a real management-credibility ding and it should be graded, not forgotten.
